long_clip_memory_stress.note: This fixed-seed sample reached the frame limit and included extra silence. Use the three transcript-matched checks for word accuracy.

limitations: Transcript cross-checks use CPU Whisper tiny.en and do not measure subjective acting quality or voice similarity.
Browser playback UI tests used fixture audio at desktop/mobile viewport widths; real GPU speech was checked through the public HTTPS API with browser cookie authentication.
Physical phones, every audio format, long paragraphs and concurrent users were not validated.
